*Pirelli Sees 2026 Global Tire Demand Falling 2% This Year
Pirelli Brightens 2026 View Despite Clouds Over Tire Market
Pirelli tweaked its 2026 revenue expectations as it looks to boost its share of the higher end of the tire market.

The Italian tire manufacturer said revenue for the full year should come in between 6.85 billion euros ($7.69 billion) and 6.95 billion euros, nudging up the lower end of a previous range of 6.75 billion euros to 6.95 billion euros.

"Pirelli expects to gain market share in the High Value segment and to continue to reduce its exposure to Standard," the company said in a release Thursday. It expects global car-tire demand to fall 2% on year over the course of 2026 as a whole. That outlook depends on the external context not worsening, the company said.

For its most recent quarter, Pirelli's revenue rose 3% organically to 1.78 billion euros, while its adjusted operating margin slipped to 15.9% from 16.3% in the same period last year. Net profit declined to 131.2 million euros on a reported basis.
